title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 27-31). Grothendieck is axiomatising the 'déploiement' (unfolding) of a locally equisingular stratification. The data has two equivalent presentations.

Presentation 1 (p. 28): a family of spaces indexed by a poset I. These are the unfolded strata Sigma_i, which morally are manifolds with boundary or corners. For i<j there are spaces Sigma_ij with two maps: s_ij : Sigma_ij -> Sigma_i, a proper fibration (the 'link bundle'), and t_ij = b_ij : Sigma_ij -> Sigma_j, the 'bordant' map, a proper immersion onto a boundary part of Sigma_j. Conditions a)-d) constrain this data.

Presentation 2 (p. 27): a topological ordered set Sigma = (Sigma(0), Sigma(1)), where Sigma(1), the graph of the order relation, lies in Sigma x Sigma. In other words Sigma is a poset internal to Top. Its source map s : Sigma(1)* -> Sigma is a proper fibration and its target map b : Sigma(1)* -> Sigma is a proper immersion. Condition 1 of p. 27 includes that for each x the set Sigma_{<x} is totally ordered. Geometrically, a point on a corner lies over a chain of smaller strata.

Previous page. From such a Sigma, with finitely many connected components, one forms the canonical increasing map Sigma -> I = pi_0(Sigma). For i<j in pi_0 one defines Sigma_ij as the part of Sigma(1)* lying over (i,j), and assumes Sigma_ij -> Sigma_j is a mono (closed embedding). This yields data (Sigma_i, Sigma_ij, s_ij, t_ij) as on p. 28.

This page.
(1) That data satisfies conditions a), c), d) of p. 28.
(2) It also satisfies condition b): Sigma_ik ∩ Sigma_jk = ∅ inside Sigma_k whenever i,j<k are incomparable. Proof: a point x in the intersection has predecessors x_i over i and x_j over j. Since Sigma_{<x} is totally ordered, x_i and x_j are comparable. Since Sigma -> pi_0 is increasing, i and j are then comparable, a contradiction. Geometrically: two boundary faces of an unfolded stratum can only meet if the strata they fibre over are comparable. This is exactly the 'iterated fibration structure' / 'manifold with fibred corners' condition.
(3) Consequence: an equivariance/equivalence of structures. 'Déploiements of equisingular stratifications indexed by I' (p. 28) are equivalent to the following data:
  (a) a topological ordered space Sigma satisfying a), b), c), 1) of p. 27; the margin adds that the components of the Sigma_i are of finite dimension (or finite in number). In addition, with Ĩ = pi_0(Sigma), each bordant morphism b_ij : Sigma_ij -> Sigma_j (i<j in Ĩ) must be a proper immersion that is a mono (embedding).
  (b) a strictly increasing map Ĩ -> I, not necessarily surjective.
In short, an unfolding indexed by I is an intrinsic topological poset whose component poset refines I, together with a coarsening map to I.

Purpose: an intrinsic, index-free description of the unfolding (dévissage) of tame stratified spaces into manifolds with boundary glued by fibrations. This is the programme announced in Esquisse d'un programme, §5.
errors: In the proof Grothendieck writes 'x et y seraient comparables'; this should read x_i and x_j. It is a harmless slip.
The step 'x_i, x_j comparable ⇒ i, j comparable' silently uses that Sigma -> pi_0(Sigma) is order-preserving. This is fine, since it holds for the canonical factorisation.

Some conditions of the equivalence are left vague: the finiteness or finite-dimensionality in the margin, and the mono/immersion requirement written as 'unmo'. The 'équivalence' is only sketched; no inverse construction is given on this page.

ideas.what: Faces of an unfolded stratum indexed by incomparable lower strata are disjoint, derived from total ordering of Sigma_{<x}
ideas.modern_name: Iterated fibration structure / manifold with fibred corners (boundary hypersurfaces meet only if strata comparable)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5 sketches the 'déploiement' and dévissage theorem in prose, without this axiomatics

ideas.what: Encoding the unfolding of a stratified space as a poset internal to Top, with s a proper fibration and b a proper immersion; index set recovered as pi_0, with a strictly increasing map to the given I
ideas.modern_name: Topological poset / internal category description of resolved (unzipped) stratified spaces; refinement of stratification to connected components
ideas.usually_credited_to: No exact counterpart known; related to Mather's abstract stratified sets and Ayala–Francis–Tanaka's conically smooth unzips

missed.claim: Grothendieck's axiom 'Sigma_{<x} totally ordered' and the derived disjointness Sigma_ik ∩ Sigma_jk = ∅ for incomparable i,j are precisely the combinatorial condition on manifolds with fibred corners (resolution of Thom–Mather spaces) used later in analysis on stratified spaces. Here they are packaged as an intrinsic topological poset whose pi_0 recovers the stratification index. This packaging is not standard in the literature.
missed.quote: Σ_{ik} ∩ Σ_{jk} = ∅ si i,j<k, i,j non comparables ? ... comme Σ_{<x} est totalt ordonné
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It gives an index-free, internal-category formulation of resolved stratified spaces. Such a formulation could interface with exit-path/∞-categorical treatments (Lurie, Ayala–Francis–Tanaka) and with Melrose-type geometric analysis.

missed.claim: The claimed equivalence between p. 28 unfoldings indexed by I and pairs (topological poset Sigma, strictly increasing map pi_0(Sigma) -> I) is stated but not fully proved. Its exact hypotheses (finite dimensionality, mono condition) are left vague.
missed.quote: Les structures "déploiements de stratifications équisingulières, indexées par I" ... équivalent à la structure suivante
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: A precise version would be a clean equivalence-of-categories statement for resolutions of stratified spaces.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a detailed unpublished axiomatisation of the 'déploiement' sketched in Esquisse. The total-ordering/disjoint-faces condition anticipates the iterated fibration structures of Melrose and Albin et al. The page's own content is a short routine verification plus a reformulation.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'satisfaisant les conditions a) c), d) de p. 28' (d) inserted above).
'x et y seraient comparables' is Grothendieck's own slip for x_i, x_j.

The 'Conséquence' sentence is garbled/duplicated in the machine transcription; it reads roughly: 'Les structures "déploiements de stratifications équisingulières, indexées par I", décrites dans la p. 28, équivalent à la structure suivante'.
'Un espace top. ordonné Σ' (a stray Σ is written before 'espace').
'N immersion propre' likely 'une immersion propre'; 'unmo' is likely the underlined word 'mono'.
The margin note reads approximately 'et les composantes des Σ_i ... de dim. finie...' (uncertain).
